title: The Little Mermaid (The Full Chronicle of the Depths)

full_text:
From the pearl palace of the Sea King to the marble terrace of the prince, the little mermaid traversed the abyss of sacrifice. She traded her golden voice for feet that bled with every step, and accepted silent suffering to win an immortal soul.

When the prince took another bride, she chose to die rather than stain her love with blood. Cast into the ocean foam, she was lifted into the radiant chorus of the Daughters of the Air, where every selfless act of compassion prepares the soul for everlasting life.
moral: The greatest love gives all, asks for nothing, and inherits the everlasting kingdom of the spirit.
